coverage.notes: This case validates authenticated gallery arrival plus assets and usage API health on the standard local-e2e lane. Direct upload is intentionally excluded.

preconditions: The demo user can sign in on the local-e2e frontend.
Playwright can start the frontend and backend webServer pair for local-e2e.
The backend gallery runtime recovery migration has been applied to the local database.
assertions: The demo user can sign in successfully.
The gallery page is displayed after authentication.
notes: Pilot local-e2e migration target for gallery runtime. Use this case as the minimum reproducible check before moving additional gallery scenarios off the local-dev exception lane.
